g.text: Build records what went wrong: escalations, reviewer findings, retries.
After the checks pass, a reflector reads the report. It returns small deltas, never a rewrite.
A soft lesson lands by itself. A rule waits as proposed.
The next spec page lists proposed rules. The owner approves them with gate H1, no extra stop.
Every implementer and reviewer prompt carries the active lessons. Any agent, any repo: it is a file.
AGENTS.md is the one index. CLAUDE.md only imports it, so no agent keeps a private copy.
